description: The quarter circle of radius 100 about (0, 100), from (0, 0) heading 0 to (100, 100) heading π/2. With d = 100√2 and φ = π/2, h = 400 (√2 − 1)/3. The ends are the nodes; the midpoint is (50√2, 100 − 50√2), on the circle, heading π/4. At t = 1/4 the point is ((27h + 1000)/64, (1000 − 9h)/64), at radius 100.026 from the centre, within 0.03 % of the circle, heading atan2(600 − 5h, 600 + 3h). The nearest point to (60√2, 100 − 60√2), 120 from the centre along the midpoint's radius, and to (40√2, 100 − 40√2), 80 from it, is the midpoint, 20 away.
